name: The Kiln-Warden's Clapper
description: The clapper of the Order's flat bell, black with the tube's heat and still warm a day after it is carried out. The Order would give a great deal to have it back, and would rather you did not ask why they never went down for it themselves.

name: Hobb Wendle's Tithe Book
description: A carter's day-book turned to a toll-roll: every tithe taken on the down since spring, in a careful hand, with the names of the carters who would not pay it written in a different ink. The Wardens at the Rest will want to see it, and so will some of the carters' families.
